node.statement: By def-maincb-partition-state, P_k=w(e_k) and k~j iff dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}=1. Because U is nonempty and U together with j lies in one equivalence class while j is not in U, every k in U satisfies k~j, so dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}=1, and R=U union {j}; the root hypothesis that the same w has one-dimensional atomic images supplies the remaining one-dimensional-image clauses.
